## About
Japanese Auto Service is a family-owned and operated shop in Wheat Ridge, near the Ward Road RTD stop. Steve Shelton started it after serving in the Marines. His son Ross grew up in the shop, followed him into the Marine Corps, and now runs the place. Steve still comes around when he feels like it, but he has to do what Ross tells him to.
Our focus is maintenance and repair of Japanese and Korean cars, including Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Acura, Subaru, Nissan, Infiniti, Mazda, Scion and Hyundai. Automatic, manual, hybrid, we can fix them all.
Matt and Amory work the service desk, Doc Jones manages the shop, and our technicians are ASE certified. Neighbors have rated us 4.9 on Google from 678 reviews.

## Services
- General Auto Repair: Engine, transmission, exhaust, brakes and electrical troubleshooting and repair, plus fluid exchanges and maintenance.
- Factory Scheduled Maintenance & Tuneups: Any factory recommended service your Honda, Acura, Toyota, Lexus, Subaru, Hyundai, Nissan or Infiniti requires.
- Hybrid Repair & Maintenance: Battery replacements and diagnostics for Japanese hybrids, including the coolant systems on the hybrid inverters.
- Brakes: Top quality brake pads, usually made by the original equipment manufacturer. We resurface rotors and drums right here in the shop.
- Alignments: Factory adjustments to improve handling and minimize tire wear, done on our Hunter wireless alignment machine.
- Emissions & Diagnostics: Doc Jones, our shop manager, is an emissions diagnosis test expert who tracks down what your car needs to pass cleaner.
- Electrical Problems: Our technicians with a military background in avionics diagnose and repair electrical problems quickly.
- Used Car Checks: Thinking about buying a used car? Bring it by first so we can look for hidden problems like flood damage or rust.

## FAQ
Q: Can you give me a price over the phone?
A: Under Colorado's new pricing transparency law, we inspect the vehicle first and send you a fully itemized written estimate by text or email. No work begins until you approve it.

Q: Is there a shop supplies fee?
A: Yes. The shop supplies fee is 2% of labor and 2% of parts, not to exceed $300, and it is listed on your estimate.

Q: What cars do you work on?
A: Japanese and Korean cars, including Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Acura, Subaru, Nissan, Infiniti, Mazda, Scion and Hyundai. Automatic, manual and hybrid.

Q: Can I wait while you work?
A: For short repairs, yes. Our lobby has complimentary WiFi, free coffee drinks, charging stations and toys for the kids. The bathroom is always clean.
